what: The gap PR #15 recorded as not done: live payment screening deciding the branch AND an on-chain settlement in the same run. Exercised on kou's machine, where both INTERCEPTA_API_KEY and X402_* are configured. The API key appears nowhere in this file, in any request line, or in any log.

server.where: 127.0.0.1:8412, started for this and stopped afterwards. Nothing on the public host was touched.

cleared.screening: clean — toxicScore 0, no traits, from the live API

confirmedFromTheChain.method: eth_getTransactionReceipt against https://sepolia.base.org, not the facilitator's response

refused.command: AGENT_TARGET=http://127.0.0.1:8412 npx tsx scripts/agent.ts routine flagged
refused.screening: flagged — toxicScore 100, from the live API
refused.reason: the payment source failed screening — known_scammer — The address has a confirmed history of malicious activity, including scams, phishing, or other harmful behavior.
refused.settlement: none. No payment was sent and no content was delivered.
refused.note: Same grant, same category, same price as the cleared run. Only the declared payment source differs.

scope: Two runs, one seller, testnet USDC. This is not observed customer traffic or revenue.
The refusal quotes the provider's own trait description. We do not write our own explanation of why an address was refused.
What was stopped is the service receiving and settling, not the buyer signing. The buyer had already signed a payment authorization.
A verdict is one input to a routing decision, not a judgement about a person, the accuracy of their data, or the legality of a transaction.
